headline: Subros inaugurates Advanced Technologies and Innovation Centre in Noida
hook: New R&D hub opens in Noida
summary: Subros Limited has officially inaugurated its new Subros Advanced Technologies & Innovation Centre (SATIC) located in Noida. The facility is aimed at boosting the company's research, development, and technological capabilities in automotive thermal management systems. For Indian retail investors, the R&D expansion highlights the company's long-term focus on product development within the auto ancillary sector.
why_it_matters: Long-term product innovation capacity strengthens the auto ancillary player.
